name: a6fdvd-u6-catalog-filter-switch
goal: a6fdvd U6: in the catalog Filters dialog, Changed only becomes a 44px switch row (label left, switch right) that toggles by clicking its label; Done stays the one primary button and Reset filters secondary (packages/desktop/src/components/explorer-ui/CatalogView.svelte)

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Design record specification/designs/full-pass/README.md section U6: in the catalog Filters dialog (packages/desktop/src/components/explorer-ui/CatalogView.svelte) Changed only must be a 44px switch row (label left, switch right) that toggles by clicking its label. Current main renders a checkbox; before--dialog-filters--laptop.png shows it. Reproduction: open Components, Filters, look for role switch named Changed only.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Existing ui-workspace.spec.ts drove Changed only through role checkbox and never asserted its control role, row height or label-click behaviour; no rendered test covered the Filters dialog row geometry. Gap: no rendered-behaviour test for the dialog's control rows. Reusable change: ui-catalog-filters.spec.ts asserts the switch role, the 44px row and label toggling at 390px; ui-workspace.spec.ts selects the switch by role.
